name: Media Do Co Ltd
summary: MEDIA DO Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the digital book distribution sector, offering a comprehensive suite of services. These include summarizing flier content, assisting with digital comic coloring and production, and providing expertise in web design, e-commerce, data management, and bibliographic information services. The company also manages a website dedicated to Japanese anime and manga, along with the video streaming application ONSTAGE. MEDIA DO develops its own girl's comic imprint, implements diverse publishing models, and handles the traditional publication and sales of books and magazines, in addition to distributing both free and commercial digital comics and other electronic publications. The firm is also involved in integrating and advancing print-on-demand (POD) publishing solutions and NetGalley, a digital marketing platform for books. Through a strategic partnership with OverDrive, Inc., MEDIA DO powers a platform enabling library patrons to easily locate, borrow, read, and return eBooks from a vast selection of local and international publishers. Established in 1996 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, the company was formerly known as Media Do Holdings Co., Ltd.
